REACHED THE GOAL.

What I did: added three tasks (one short, one a full sentence, one more short), ticked 'Buy milk' as done, tried the Active and Completed filters, renamed two tasks, then removed everything so the list was empty again.

What worked: adding with Enter or the Add button, the checkbox and strike-through on completion, the 'N left' counter, and the per-row Delete buttons. Long text shows fine once it is in the list, wrapping to two lines.

What behaved differently from what I expected:

1. Long task got chopped when added. I typed a full sentence about calling the dentist and pressed Add. Only the first six words, 'Call the dentist to reschedule', went into the list. No warning, no ellipsis, no character limit shown. Opening Edit confirmed the rest was gone, not just hidden. Retyping the full sentence in the edit box and pressing Enter kept all of it, so the limit only applies to the Add box.

2. The Save button in edit mode does nothing. I clicked it three times across two edits, with both a long and a short name. The row stayed in edit mode with no message. Pressing Enter in the text box saved fine each time. I only found that by guessing.

3. Active and Completed filters are swapped. With one task ticked and two unticked, Active showed only the ticked, struck-through task. Completed showed the two unfinished ones. The counter under the list was right both times, so only the filter buttons are backwards.

4. Clear completed does nothing. With 'Buy milk' ticked, I clicked it twice. The task stayed. I had to delete it with its own Delete button.

5. The empty list shows the word 'undefined'. I saw this on first load and again after deleting everything. It reads like a bug leaking through rather than a message meant for me.

6. Edit doesn't put the cursor in the text box. The first time I clicked Edit and started typing, my keystrokes went to the page instead: Ctrl+A highlighted the whole screen. I had to click into the box first.

Where I hesitated: after the first Save click did nothing I wasn't sure whether the app was slow or broken, so I clicked again and waited before trying Enter. When Active showed me the finished task, I paused to check Completed before trusting my read that the two were reversed. After Clear completed failed, I wondered whether I was meant to select something first, but nothing on screen suggested that.
